assertion_review.failure_condition: Barrier release or arrival fails within 30 seconds; a fixture missing the production promotion path fails before acquisition is judged.
No real first-run acquisition by the sweep, or no sweep started; these prevent an empty fixture passing.
Restoring the enclosing pointer-lock block makes the contender wait five seconds and fail; a delayed but successful acquisition also fails the independent one-second clock bound.
Any observed lock survives joined sweeps, or promotion fails to retire the delivered pointer.

Restoring unconditional unlink removes the replacement pointer and fails the expected CrewError and subsequent attempt/pid reads. The expected injected identity is not tautological: deletion or rollback destroys that observable state.
Dropping the promotion flock lets nonblocking flock succeed inside pytest.raises; skipping the check leaves checked empty; leaking the lock prevents post-promotion reacquisition.
Holding the pointer lock through workspace cleanup prevents the competing thread acquiring within one second; skipped withdrawal or retirement fails the returned receipt booleans.

Restoring stale-record _write_json removes probe_observation; disabling refusal removes SuiteDeltaError or its persisted status. The supplied fresh marker is checked after an intervening refusal write that formerly lost it, so the assertion is regression-sensitive.
